title: Little flimsy.
text:
Little flimsy.. Little flimsy for what it cost. Do like the features of able to adjust height, slant the top up or down. Overall not a bad product but cost more than I think it should. I did get the set of two so price was 70 at my time of purchase. I would not put any weight on the edge when using as laptop table as it will not hold much. Also would not purchase for kids or accident prone adults.
Update. It is still doing ok but I have discovered it is easy to pop out of the hooks on bottom when just sliding it over or even moving it back. So he careful with whatever you use it for. But fun having a laptop get smashed it picking up thousands of beads.
